about: SHADER layers (r180, docs/effect-layers.md phase 3): conformance pages with a layer drawn through WAVE and a white mist band (core/test-data/shaders/mist.png, in HiverFog.atlas) drawn through FOG, in every repeat mode, a checker through SWELL (r431), and a cross-fade into the page on screen while tinting. The effects move on the reader's clock, so t6 and t12 catch them at different phases. Written by core/test-data/shaders/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-X
scenes.about: c01 (repeat X, trimmed regions): the near hills (a trimmed region) ripple, a mist band drifts through FOG between the two front layers. Lint (b), known: layer 0's bottom edge (parallax4#3 at 68%) shows flat through the hills' gaps, Hiver's own 2019 layout, kept (r405).

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-XY
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a ripple running down, a padded mist tiled both ways

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-Y-mirror
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored copies to the right), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a mirrored layer ripples with its copy, a flipped mirrored hill thins through FOG

scenes.name: wave-fog-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat): a flipped layer ripples wide, clamped to its region; a WAVE with no wavelength draws plain; a FOG amplitude of 1.7 thins at most fully

scenes.name: shaders-cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: s01 cross-fading into itself (its layers cloned) while tinting orange: both pages shade on one clock, faded and tinted

scenes.name: fog-across-the-tiles
scenes.about: r229: the mist alone, 20 of 40 units wide, its noise period (40) twice the image, tiling on X over near-black gradients: the noise runs on across every tile edge, also after the layer wraps (t6, t12), instead of starting again at each

scenes.name: fog-up-the-tiles
scenes.about: r262: an even slab through FOG, 20 of 40 units wide and 5 tall, its noise period up (50) ten times the image, tiling on Y and scrolled up so it wraps there (t6, t12): the noise runs on across every tile edge on Y instead of starting again at each

scenes.name: wave-up-the-tiles
scenes.about: r273: black and white vertical stripes through WAVE (amplitude 0.3), 20 of 40 units wide and 5 tall, its wavelength (1.5) not dividing the image, tiling on Y and scrolled up so it wraps there (t6, t12): the ripple runs on across every tile edge on Y instead of jumping sideways at each

scenes.name: swell-across-the-tiles
scenes.about: r431: a black and white checker through SWELL (amplitude 0.3, the animation lab's wavelength 1.25 and speed 0.3), 18 of 40 units wide (no whole number of its 10-unit period), tiling on X and wrapped by the scroll (t6, t12): the squares bent by two crossing travelling waves, which are whole turns over 8 wavelengths across, so they run on across every tile edge and the wrap

scenes.name: swell-flipped-no-repeat
scenes.about: r431: the same checker through SWELL, the world's width, repeating on neither axis and flipped on X: the waves run leftward from its right edge (along() turned), its sides and its top and bottom rows held: it repeats on neither axis (r434)

scenes.name: swell-up-the-tiles
scenes.about: r434: the checker through SWELL, 10 of 40 units wide and 2.5 tall, tiling on X and Y and scrolled up so it wraps on Y (t6, t12): the image wrapped on both axes, so the squares stay bent across every tile edge on Y instead of a flat band of held rows at each

scenes.name: mirror-beach-sea
scenes.about: r455: r407's beach sea alone through MIRROR at Simon's r419 numbers (SWELL 0.12, 1.25, 0.35; glint 0.5), its horizon at the strip's 84 of 384 rows (mirrorHorizon 0.21875) and 3 units deep, mirroring the beach page's top gradient (pale at the horizon, blue over the view): the facets bend the water's own colour brighter or darker as the swell tilts them, the glint in a sun's column at a quarter of the view. tools/r455-mirror/strength.sh: the mirror moves it past the gate against the same sea through SWELL

scenes.name: mirror-flipped-no-repeat
scenes.about: r455: s12's sea flipped on Y and repeating on neither axis: the horizon is a row of the image, so the mirror turns with it, the swell's sides held

scenes.name: mirror-odd-sky
scenes.about: r455: s12's sea through MIRROR under a sky no page would paint (its page's top gradient violet at the horizon, green over the view), a stronger swell (0.3) and shallower water (1.5 units), no glint: the mirror's hue, bent in grey, and its three fine ripples show (a sky white at the horizon, a bend in colour or no ripples fails here, not on s12)

scenes.name: detail-medium-mirror
scenes.about: r464: s14's page at detail MEDIUM: its MIRROR layer drawn through SWELL, the reflection's hue and ripples gone (ParallaxPageReader.setDetail; Godot's PlaxDetail). A reader that ignores the level draws s14 here

scenes.name: detail-off-swell
scenes.about: r464: s09's checker at detail OFF: the SHADER layer drawn as its painting, the squares straight. A reader that ignores the level bends them

scenes.name: detail-default-keeps-mirror
scenes.about: r464: s14's page at MEDIUM, every layer's rule keeping MIRROR's reflection from MEDIUM (setLayerDefaultDetail): drawn as s14. A reader that ignores the rule draws s15

scenes.name: detail-off-named-mist-hidden
scenes.about: r464: s03's page at OFF, the layer named mist shown from MEDIUM only (setLayerDetail): no mist, its WAVE and other FOG layers drawn as paintings. A reader that ignores the name draws the mist
